## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## User impact

Who benefits from this change? Note any behavior, output, compatibility, or performance implications.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] `python -m build` passes when packaging behavior changes
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior changes

## Reproduction or usage example

Include a small command, input fixture, or report excerpt that demonstrates the change.

## Compatibility

List any breaking changes or migration notes.
